changelog:
A new bell in the top bar collects system notices: what needs attention now, like a missing recording drive, an offline camera or a lost Site Manager link, and recent events such as drive errors and updates.
The mobile app gets the same bell in the Live header.
Alerts has a new siren icon and a blue count badge.
When the recorder can't be reached, a message says so and offers Retry now.
Editing a camera's IP address, port or password no longer makes it stop recording.
A camera manager limited to some cameras can only attach cameras to DVRs they have access to.
A user's role and camera access now save together, so a failed save can't leave a new role with the old access.
Retrying a DVR save no longer creates duplicate DVRs or channels.
PTZ cameras stop moving when you let go, and typing in the preset field no longer moves the camera.
Long downloads recover from dropped connections, and cancelling a multi-camera ZIP stops it.
Timeline hour labels match local time, including across daylight saving changes.
Paused live tiles stop streaming, and offline tiles in the mobile app retry on their own.
Camera passwords no longer appear in stream error messages.
In the Site Manager, a successful password change no longer reports "Failed", and the live wall picks up new sites without a reload.
The Delete Account dialogs spell out what gets deleted, including off-site backups.
Deleting an alert or removing a zone asks for confirmation, and first-time setup asks you to confirm the password.
Dialogs with three choices stack their buttons.
